item.text: I’ll trace how plan checks read subscriptions and workspace records, then update them and the trial sweep.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc "cat src/server/repositories/organization-repository.ts src/server/repositories/subscription-repository.ts src/server/services/billing-service.ts src/server/jobs/trial-expiry-job.ts; rg -n '\\.plan|getOrgPlan|resolve.*Plan' src/server src/app src/lib; cat package.json"

item.text: The quota, feature, burst-limit, and display paths all read organizations through the same repository. I’ll make those reads return the subscription’s current plan, with the stored workspace plan as the fallback. The trial sweep also needs a status check: it currently selects expired paid subscriptions even after they’ve left trial.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/server/repositories/organization-repository.ts'
s=open(p).read().replace(' * Organization rows plus slug uniqueness lookups.', ' * Organization rows plus slug uniqueness lookups. Returned plans come from\\n * the subscription when present; the stored organization plan is a fallback.')
s=s.replace('import { toOrganization } from \"./_mappers\";', 'import { toOrganization } from \"./_mappers\";\\nimport { findSubscription } from \"./subscription-repository\";\\nimport type { OrganizationRow } from \"@/server/db/schema/organizations\";')
s=s.replace('return row ? toOrganization(row) : null;', 'return row ? withCurrentPlan(row) : null;')
s=s.replace('return rows.map((row) => toOrganization(row.org));', 'return Promise.all(rows.map((row) => withCurrentPlan(row.org)));')
s=s.replace('return toOrganization(row);', 'return withCurrentPlan(row);')
s += '''\\n/** Resolve on every read so existing mismatches and plan changes take effect. */
async function withCurrentPlan(row: OrganizationRow): Promise<Organization> {
  const organization = toOrganization(row);
  const subscription = await findSubscription(organization.id);
  return subscription
    ? { ...organization, plan: subscription.plan }
    : organization;
}
'''
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/server/repositories/subscription-repository.ts'
s=open(p).read().replace('import { and, isNotNull, lte, ne }', 'import { and, eq, isNotNull, lte, ne }')
s=s.replace(' * Every paid subscription starts life as a trial whose first period is the\\n * trial window, so \"a paid plan whose period has run out\" is the whole test.', ' * Only subscriptions still trialing can expire; choosing a plan ends the trial\\n * even when its original period end remains in the past.')
s=s.replace('        isNotNull(subscriptions.currentPeriodEnd),', '        eq(subscriptions.status, \"trialing\"),\\n        isNotNull(subscriptions.currentPeriodEnd),')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY"
